theorem algebra_amgm_sum1toneqn_prod1tonleq1
  (a : ℕ → NNReal)
  (n : ℕ)
  (h₀ : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x = n) :
  ∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x ≤ 1 := by
  -- Convert the problem to Real numbers for easier manipulation
  let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => (a i : ℝ)
  -- Show that each b i is non-negative since a i is in NNReal
  have h₁ : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, 0 ≤ b i := by
    intro i hi
    exact NNReal.coe_nonneg (a i)
  -- Apply the AM-GM inequality: geometric mean ≤ arithmetic mean
  have h₂ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, b x) ^ (1 / n : ℝ) ≤ (∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, b x) / n := by
    apply Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted
    · intro i hi
      exact h₁ i hi
    · simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range]
    · simp [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_range]
  -- Use the given condition that the sum equals n
  have h₃ : (∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, b x) = n := by
    simp [b] at h₀ ⊢
    exact_mod_cast h₀
  -- Substitute the sum value into the AM-GM inequality
  rw [h₃] at h₂
  -- Simplify the right side: n / n = 1
  have h₄ : (n : ℝ) / n = 1 := by
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · simp_all
    · field_simp [hn]
  rw [h₄] at h₂
  -- Raise both sides to power n to get the product bound
  have h₅ : ∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, b x ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · -- Case n = 0: empty product is 1
      simp_all [Finset.prod_empty]
    · -- Case n > 0: use the inequality from AM-GM
      have h₆ : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
      have h₇ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, b x) ≤ 1 := by
        calc
          (∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, b x) = ((∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, b x) ^ (1 / n : ℝ)) ^ n := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]
            rw [← Real.rpow_mul] <;> norm_num <;> linarith
          _ ≤ (1 : ℝ) ^ n := by gcongr
          _ = 1 := by simp
      exact_mod_cast h₇
  -- Convert back to NNReal
  exact_mod_cast h₅
